caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of different trigger words under a clean-label poisoning attack with a poison rate of 10% (2.5% of the total dataset), on the AGNews dataset. The horizontal axis displays trigger words arranged in ascending order of the clean model’s ASR: "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics". The vertical axis represents ASR, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a linear scale and tick marks at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. Three lines are plotted: a green dashed line with circle markers labeled "start", an orange dashed line with cross markers labeled "random", and a purple dashed line with circle markers labeled "end". The "start" line begins at approximately 0.77 for "cf", dips to 0.5 for "bb", rises to 0.9 at "WNBA", then gradually decreases to around 0.88 at "athletics". The "random" line starts at 0.63 for "cf", drops to 0.5 for "bb", rises to 0.85 at "WNBA", and ends at 0.87 at "athletics". The "end" line begins at 0.75 for "cf", drops to 0.57 for "bb", peaks at 0.9 at "WNBA", and ends at 0.82 for "athletics". All three lines show a sharp increase in ASR at "WNBA" and a general decline afterward, with the "start" and "end" lines showing similar trends but differing slightly in magnitude at later points.
